notes: This bundle template is not performance evidence.

It defines external workload handoff rules for every paper row that is not locally runnable through the in-tree Collections driver; the default all-paper-data bundle currently includes macro rows plus web/platform rows.
Leave template_only=true until workload_dir, command_template, allocator selection, and stdout JSON timing have been wired to real benchmark repositories.
paper_external_workload.py refuses template_only rules and missing workload directories, so this template cannot accidentally produce synthetic timing data.
Each workload rule embeds paper_source metadata so source/ref audits are reproducible from the bundle artifact, not only from evaluator defaults.

sample_contract.claim_grade_rule: every successful sample must carry command provenance, host/target provenance, verified raw evidence paths or URIs, and sha256 digests for the raw evidence
